initial_review: Original cmdSetInfo stores GetVDMAddr(DS,DX), and cmdCheckBinary later subtracts GetVDMAddr(0,0) to recover guest addresses. Coherent restoration must include registration; a zero global after consumer-only restoration proves nothing.
counter_review: GetVDMAddr uses Sim32pGetVDMPointer with pm=FALSE, which forms segment*16+offset but still calls c_GetLinAdd. c_GetLinAdd applies paging when PG is set. Thus pm=FALSE does not establish a fixed host alias. Original host-pointer subtraction requires uniform translation offset across SCS and zero; whether the real SCS pages violate this remains unproved.
fixture_limit: Existing fixture has one contiguous 64KiB array and current composition; it does not prove original registration lifetime or nonuniform SCS mapping failure.
next_required_evidence: Identify actual SCS registration and access mapping in supported enhanced-mode command path; determine whether same registration survives mapping change and whether pointer subtraction yields the registered far address. Do not infer failure merely from mapper capability.
